source.name: Football Shirt Culture: Spain 2026 Adidas Home Kit
source.quote: On the chest, the RFEF crest and adidas logo are centrally placed in yellow, following the layout used across other adidas 26 national team kits.
source.note: Kit maker, listed as partner per the convention for kit suppliers. FSC's launch description covers every mark on the shirt: the RFEF crest and adidas logo on the chest, "España" on the upper back, with the full strip completed by navy shorts with yellow and red side stripes and navy socks. No commercial sponsor on any placement.

summary: No sponsors on the shirt: adidas's red 2026 home shirt (fine yellow pinstripes, navy sleeves and collar trim) for the 2026 World Cup cycle carries only the RFEF crest and adidas logo centrally in yellow, with 'España' on the upper back; navy shorts and socks complete the strip (Football Shirt Culture's launch description).
